projects.title: Metropolis Corporate Twin Towers
projects.description: A landmark 1.45M sq.ft Grade-A commercial skyscraper development featuring seismic dampening systems, high-speed vertical transportation, and LEED Platinum sustainability standards.
projects.longDescription: Awarded as a turnkey Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) mandate, the Metropolis Corporate Twin Towers stands as a defining silhouette on the Mumbai skyline. The project encompasses two 48-storey high-rise commercial towers interconnected by a panoramic skybridge at Level 30. Built with high-performance C60/75 self-consolidating concrete and post-tensioned floor plates, the structure integrates passive solar orientation, double-laminated low-E curtain walling, and deep geothermal piling through fractured basalt geology. The project achieved full practical handover 2 months ahead of schedule with over 6.5 million safe man-hours without Lost Time Injury (LTI).
projects.client: Apex Global Asset Management & Institutional Real Estate Trust
projects.scope: Turnkey EPC, Deep Substructure Piling, Core-and-Shell Civil Works, Advanced MEP & Façade Glazing
highlights: LEED Platinum Certified Green Building Design
Custom Tuned Mass Dampers for Seismic & Wind Sway Neutralization
100% On-Site Greywater Treatment & Dual Plumbing Distribution
Over 6.5 Million Safe Man-Hours without Lost Time Injury (LTI)

The super-hub features 120 automated hydraulic dock levelers, 14-meter clear working heights, pre-engineered high-tensile steel portal frames, and a dedicated 3.2 MW rooftop solar canopy capable of powering the entire facility off-grid during daytime peak hours. Built with jointless post-tensioned concrete slab flooring (FM2 special tolerance) capable of supporting 10-ton point loads.
